 Board of Trustees to meet today; special issue of Purdue Today to follow
 November 5, 2026 
 Purdue Today
 Share
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Print 
 A special meeting of the Purdue Board of Trustees will be held at 3:30 p.m. (ET) today (Nov. 5). A livestream will be available here .
 A special issue of Purdue Today will be issued following the meeting.
